text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- United Nations special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye returned to Angola on Tuesday and said the implementation of a two-year-old peace accord between the government and the former UNITA rebel movement was on track.
- Angola's Interior Minister Santana Andre Petroff appealed to UNITA in the northern enclave of Cabinda to realise the need to conclude the implementation of the Lusaka Protocol.
- The main road linking the provincial capitals of Lubango and Huambo, closed since 1992 due to the war, has officially been opened after demining operations.
